story:
The fair

Andy, Terry and Jill were trying to win a science fair. They were in the sunroom discussing what they were gonna do and after the big big discussion... They decided to do a volcano a fake one obviously why would it be real.

But the twist was they only had 100 bucks to spend like the whole class that budget. So they decided to go to the cheapest store in town called Pinchee McPinchy McPhee's 2 dollar shop. It was great. Everything was two dollars so it was possible to get 50 items. They ended up buying a lot of material.
